title: kate-core: choose the cmake and xml newline from the indenter name
summary: newline_for_indenter maps the indenter name cmake to cmake_newline and xml to xml_newline, with ASCII case folding like python and cstyle. The dead_code attributes on the two functions go away. A CMake or XML document now indents its blocks on Enter.

lane.reason: Either lane may code this packet. It is one file, one behavior, and one test, and the rule text in this packet is the oracle. The first idle lane takes it.

definitions.definition:
/// python, cstyle, cmake, and xml pick their newline. Any other name copies the indent.
pub fn newline_for_indenter(indenter: Option<&str>, buf: &TextBuffer, at: Offset, config: &DocumentConfig) -> String

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add two match arms before the fallback. Remove the cfg_attr dead_code lines from cmake_newline and xml_newline. The test newline_for_indenter_knows_cmake_and_xml asserts Some("CMake") after if(x) gives one unit, Some("xml") after gives one unit, and Some("xml") after gives none. Do not nest an if inside an if. When two arms return the same value, write one condition with ||. Add each new test at the end of the one test module of the file, before its closing brace; create that module when the file is new. Do not write a second mod tests. An item with no caller outside tests gets #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]; the packet that adds the caller removes it. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: workspace::indent::tests::newline_for_indenter_knows_cmake_and_xml
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because the two names fall through to the plain newline. After the change they pick the CMake and XML rules.
